requirement: For each {term}`requirements.sdk.graph.search.hit` in a text or structural search, locate the start of the match in the outline of the **same snapshot**. Select the innermost item containing that position. The item's project-relative file path and selector form its `OutlineData`. When no smaller item contains the position, use the file root (empty selector).
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.sdk.graph.search.enclosing_item`.

- **Text and structural search.** `search_text` hits are tested in `search_in_leading_and_trailing_comments_selects_the_function`, `root_hits_clip_context_to_utf8_boundaries`, `matches_crossing_item_boundaries_belong_to_the_item_at_the_start` and `separated_hit_windows_preserve_the_function_declaration`. `search_structure` hits are tested in `structural_tags_select_only_the_original_enclosing_item`.
- **Innermost item.** `separated_hit_windows_preserve_the_function_declaration` asserts that hits inside a method resolve to the nested node `runner.rs#impl[Runner]/fn[run]`, not to `impl[Runner]`. The structural test asserts that two `call()` hits resolve to `code.rs#fn[one]` and `code.rs#fn[two]`, with their span starts and texts.
- **Start of match decides.** `matches_crossing_item_boundaries_belong_to_the_item_at_the_start` has three patterns. A match starting in the gap before `fn b` resolves to the root `pair.rs#`. A match starting at `}` resolves to `fn[a]`. A match starting at `fn b` resolves to `fn[b]`. All three assert the exact node.
- **Comments.** `search_in_leading_and_trailing_comments_selects_the_function` asserts that both hits in the leading and trailing comments resolve to `example.rs#fn[check]`.
- **Root fallback.** `root_hits_clip_context_to_utf8_boundaries` asserts a hit in a file with no items resolves to `fragment.rs#`, for both an ASCII source and a multibyte one. It also checks that the read node is the file root.
- **Same snapshot.** `structural_tags_select_only_the_original_enclosing_item` rewrites the file after the first search. Later paged searches and `finish_search` still resolve to the original `code.rs#fn[two]`. `separated_hit_windows_preserve_the_function_declaration` rewrites the file between loop iterations. The node stays `runner.rs#impl[Runner]/fn[run]`, and the read text stays the original.
- **Path and selector.** The nodes are asserted as `path#selector` strings. Every test file sits at the project root, so no test has a file in a subdirectory. I read `crates/trust-but-verify/src/sources/hits.rs#impl[SourceProject<D>]/fn[find_hits]`, the item carrying the {impl} reference. It takes `path` unchanged from `sources.list(scope)` and builds `OutlineData { path, selector }`. Because that path is passed through without transformation, the missing subdirectory case does not count as a gap.

I found no unacknowledged gap.
